    model.OD = pyo.Set(initialize=[p[0] for p in d["od_pairs"]], ordered=True)

    model.fixed_cost = pyo.Param(model.L, initialize=d["fixed_cost"])
    model.op_cost = pyo.Param(model.L, initialize=d["op_cost"])
    model.veh_per_trip = pyo.Param(model.L, initialize=d["veh_per_trip"])
    model.demand = pyo.Param(
        model.OD, initialize={p[0]: p[1] for p in d["od_pairs"]}
    )
    model.penalty = pyo.Param(
        model.OD, initialize={p[0]: p[2] for p in d["od_pairs"]}
    )
    model.od_min_freq = pyo.Param(model.OD, initialize=d["od_min_freq"])

    # ---------------- Decision Variables ----------------
    # z[l] = 1 if line l is selected
    model.z = pyo.Var(model.L, within=pyo.Binary)

    # f[l] = frequency of line l (trips per unit time)
    model.f = pyo.Var(
        model.L,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=(0, d["freq_max"]),
    )

    # y[s] = 1 if station s is a transfer station
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.S, within=pyo.Binary)

    # u[od] = unmet demand for OD pair
    model.u = pyo.Var(model.OD, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---------------- Objective ----------------

        fixed = sum(m.fixed_cost[l] * m.z[l] for l in m.L)
        oper = sum(m.op_cost[l] * m.f[l] for l in m.L)
        pen = sum(m.penalty[od] * m.u[od] for od in m.OD)
        return fixed + oper + pen

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ---------------- Constraints ----------------

    # (1) Frequency bounds: freq_min * z[l] <= f[l] <= freq_max * z[l]
    def freq_lb_rule(m, l):
        return m.f[l] >= d["freq_min"] * m.z[l]

    def freq_ub_rule(m, l):
        return m.f[l] <= d["freq_max"] * m.z[l]

    model.freq_lb = pyo.Constraint(model.L, rule=freq_lb_rule)
    model.freq_ub = pyo.Constraint(model.L, rule=freq_ub_rule)

    # (2) Fleet capacity: sum_l veh_per_trip[l] * f[l] <= fleet_capacity
    def fleet_rule(m):
        return sum(m.veh_per_trip[l] * m.f[l] for l in m.L) <= d["fleet_capacity"]

    model.fleet = pyo.Constraint(rule=fleet_rule)

    # (3) OD demand satisfaction with unmet demand:
    #     sum_{l in od_lines[od]} f[l] + u[od] >= demand[od]
    def od_demand_rule(m, od):
        serving = d["od_lines"][od]
        return sum(m.f[l] for l in serving) + m.u[od] >= m.demand[od]

    model.od_demand = pyo.Constraint(model.OD, rule=od_demand_rule)

    # (4) OD minimum service frequency:
    #     sum_{l in od_lines[od]} f[l] >= od_min_freq[od]
    def od_minfreq_rule(m, od):
        serving = d["od_lines"][od]
        return sum(m.f[l] for l in serving) >= m.od_min_freq[od]

    model.od_minfreq = pyo.Constraint(model.OD, rule=od_minfreq_rule)

    # (5) Transfer station logic:
    #     y[s] = 1 only if at least two lines through s are selected.
    #     For stations with < 2 candidate lines, y[s] is forced to 0.
    def transfer_rule(m, s):
        lines_at_s = d["station_lines"][s]
        if len(lines_at_s) < 2:

        # (|lines_at_s| - 1) * y[s] <= sum z[l] - 1
        return (len(lines_at_s) - 1) * m.y[s] <= sum(m.z[l] for l in lines_at_s) - 1

    model.transfer = pyo.Constraint(model.S, rule=transfer_rule)

    return model
